W.note: Compact 52px row that expands through an animated grid transition into a clear step rail with times, expected windows, carrier and tracking number, with exception actions and proper aria-expanded, inert panel and live region.

X.note: Starts fully expanded with a multi-package list and add form, so it is not compact at rest, and the collapse uses the hidden attribute so it snaps with no transition; the tracking detail itself is strong.

Y.note: Starts as a one-line summary with a useful count, and the expanded multi-package list has status tags, progress bars and ETAs, but the panel appears and disappears instantly, the 10 to 11px text is dense, and the repeated Next scan and Remove buttons lack package context for screen readers.

Z.note: The most compact and cleanly animated single-parcel toast with a pulsing status dot and a keep-open control, but the open panel never shows the carrier or tracking number and its footer note stays on the stale Ready text.
